lead_independence.headline: Tradition Lakes K-8 school opening delayed one week, leaving Port St. Lucie area parents scrambling for child care
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie Public Schools announced Thursday that the first day of classes at the new Tradition Lakes K-8 school will be pushed from Aug. 10 to Aug. 17, affecting approximately 1,100 students. Parents received notification of the delay just four days before the originally scheduled opening, sparking frustration among families who had already arranged work schedules and child care around the initial start date.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Search warrant executed at Fort Pierce home in $7 million Southern Truss fraud investigation

lead_independence.headline: Search warrant executed at Fort Pierce home in $7 million Southern Truss fraud investigation
lead_independence.lead: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office deputies served a search warrant Tuesday morning as part of the ongoing investigation into the Southern Truss fraud case. Crime scene investigators were seen outside the home of Laura Beth Grasso in the Indian River Estates neighborhood near Sunset Boulevard in Fort Pierce. Grasso was arrested July 16 along with Sheri Lynn Harrs and Tina Marie Mejia following what the sheriff's office described as a years-long scheme targeting Southern Truss Companies. Grasso has pleaded not guilty to the charges, court records show.
